Title: Azure preview portal: tile customization improvements

Body.Content: In the Azure preview portal, you can now quickly access the context menu for tiles and remove tiles on blades or the start screen by using a menu that appears when your mouse hovers over a tile. This removes the need to right-click tiles to see the menu. You can also remove tiles using the X icon. Note that you can (still) tap and hold to access the context menu while on a touch device. Be sure to leave feedback about this feature or any experience you have while using the portal.
